title: Washington reacts to the outages: lawmakers demand answers, DHS chief points to AI
what_changed: Summary said Trump, Clayton, Mullin and the White House all say they see no cyberattack. Sources show Mullin said he was 98 percent certain there was no cyberattack and Clayton said it was not a coordinated nation-state effort; Trump did not explicitly deny a cyberattack. Also attributed the lawmaker patching link to CyberScoop only (Nextgov cites unnamed people). Summary, plain and exec reworded.
